construct_full_name: Type-Conditional Dormancy with Integrity Gate (TCD-IG) + Design A documentation/diagnostics
owner_approval_quote: Approve Design Gate: B-leaning hybrid with κ; accept checklist items 1–15; accept Grok Auto for this pass
population: Open eligible 311 requests in the frozen snapshot decision set at as-of T (one row per SR_NUMBER)

decision_window.boundary_semantics: First-pass bounded feasibility: T aligns with frozen snapshot; historical as-of open without status history out of scope. Locked per checklist item 4.

open_definition.rule: STATUS parses to Open (case/whitespace-normalized) per locked Open-token list

eligible_skeleton.non_exclusions: Do not exclude solely by request type, geography, age, or workload difficulty

urgency_definition.primary_statistic: dormant_h = T - mod_ts (hours); require mod_ts >= created_ts
urgency_definition.peer_p75_h: 75th percentile of (closed - created) hours on Completed non-dup non-legacy historical peers same type_key with created in lookback W ending at T
urgency_definition.open_age_h: diagnostic only — T - created_ts; NOT a decision/escalate trigger
urgency_definition.peer_p75_label: empirical Completed-peer statistic — never labeled or used as City SLA

evidence.closed_ts: Parsed CLOSED_DATE; used for integrity on open rows
evidence.peer_n: Count of Completed non-dup non-legacy peers in lookback W

order: Not in decision set → emit no label
ESCALATE if not integrity_fail and dormant_h >= kappa * peer_p75_h
decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: integrity gate: Open-like with parseable closed_ts; created_ts or mod_ts unparseable or mod_ts < created_ts; created_ts > T; blank type_key; thin_type (peer_n < n_min); DUPLICATE unparseable if retained; PARENT_SR_NUMBER orphan; Open-like STATUS not in locked Open-token list
decision_rules.ESCALATE: not integrity_fail AND dormant_h >= kappa * peer_p75_h
decision_rules.STANDARD: open, eligible, coherent, not dormant-relative-to-type at current kappa

selected_definition: selected := (action == 'ESCALATE'); unordered partition; no capacity rank / shortlist

locked_knob.name: kappa
locked_knob.warrant: how many type-cycles of silence count as warranting elevation; portfolio simulation — NOT City SLA

method_constants.note: Not owner-tunable knobs; changing them is a design change

source_delivery_contract.summary: Method B: SQL nonjudgmental extract + peer aggregates; R judges labels. SQL must not assign ESCALATE/INCONCLUSIVE/STANDARD or apply kappa. Mechanical envelope targets open-scale candidates (~245k), not full 14.6M rows to R.

capacity.rule: If ESCALATE volume exceeds attention, return to Framing with new candidate question (hard cap + ranking). Do not add secondary sort here. Lowering kappa is not a capacity tool.

1.item: Lock candidate = B-leaning hybrid (TCD-IG); not Design A confidence-age as primary

5.item: Open = locked Open-token list (default Open); other statuses out of decision set

7.item: Default exclude DUPLICATE true-like and LEGACY_RECORD true-like; require type_key; CREATED_DATE ≤ T

8.item: Unresolved PARENT_SR_NUMBER → INCONCLUSIVE; no cluster collapse

9.item: Lock date-parse + timezone rule (date-level OK; hour-level deferred until tz locked)

10.item: open_age_h diagnostic only — not escalate trigger

11.item: Peer P75 labeled empirical, not City SLA on all outputs

12.item: Fixture outline F01–F14 (esp. F03) as construct sign-off

13.item: Capacity/ranking out of Stage 3; excess ESCALATE → return to Framing

14.item: SQL may emit peer aggregates; SQL must not emit labels

16.item: Accept AI2 produced under Grok Auto (not Comprehensive) for this pass

AI2.note: Comprehensive unavailable this run; owner accepted Grok Auto for this pass

superseded.note: Prior MEASUREMENT_DESIGN / stage3-v0.1 age-threshold scratch superseded by stage3-v1-tcd-ig B-leaning hybrid
